assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
Given the clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I49.5)
prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered
This service addresses the intermittent nature of the symptoms that require extended monitoring beyond standard ambulatory monitoring.
